title: CoachEvaluation
description: Real-time AI Coach evaluation of the user's current focus, fatigue, and context state with intervention generation

trigger.description: Primary trigger that caused this evaluation state

evidence.description: Structured human-readable telemetry evidence driving the evaluation

intervention.description: Actionable coaching message, or null if suppressed or not needed

confidence.description: Confidence level based on historical calibration and signal volume

isInterventionSuppressed.description: True if an intervention was suppressed by anti-spam policies

suppressionReason.description: Reason for suppression: COOLDOWN_ACTIVE, DUPLICATE_TRIGGER, LOW_CONFIDENCE, SEVERITY_BELOW_THRESHOLD, or null

structuredEvidence.description: Machine-readable telemetry facts ready for local open-source LLM consumption
